param: A Recruitment/birth rate into the susceptible population (all newborns are susceptible per assumption A1)
β Transmission (effective contact) rate leading to TB infection via contact between susceptible and infected individuals
δ Rate of loss of temporary natural immunity: recovered individuals return to susceptible
μ Natural death rate (applies to all compartments)
u Vaccination rate moving susceptible individuals to vaccinated
θ Vaccine waning rate: vaccinated individuals lose protection and return to susceptible
ε Reinfection coefficient modifying infection of recovered individuals upon contact with infected (reinfection term)
γ Recovery rate from infected to recovered
